metadata.description: Private GitHub Copilot plugin marketplace for development workflow skills

plugins.name: dev-workflows
plugins.description: Full product-development lifecycle for GitHub Copilot CLI. Twenty user-facing skills covering the idea → create-vi → create-ard → specify → design → epics → implement → document → release-notes → ready flow, plus vuln (CVE remediation), upgrade (dependency upgrades), update-vi (VI refresh), api-guideline-reviewer, guideline-reviewer, docs-profile, feedback, prompt, prompt-brainstorm, and prompt-grill-me. Flat keyword triggers (e.g. implement:, document:, specify:, release-notes:). document: grounds space-constrained runs on the counterpart space's existing docs as read-only reference, proposes deprecation/announcement pages via a profiled announcement_pages block, writes rendered pages with no source provenance (traceability lives in the commit and run handoff), reviews callout scope and sibling component-pattern reuse, and folds new-and-stale screenshot handling into one always-running image phase. release-notes: routes each note to its destination (breaking-changes / feature-updates / fixes), shapes the Summary per destination, and sources the {{#context}} label from the imported VI. Thirty-two dispatched sub-agents for planning, code review, doc review, testing, style-checking, and Jira/PR analysis. Strong-tier model routing (Opus 5/4.8/4.7/4.6 or GPT-5.6/5.5). Notification, context-injection, and dynatrace-docs frontmatter hooks. Phase 0 toolchain preflight + gate ledger: every verification gate records an outcome the orchestrator cannot fake, and a run started without the required tooling stops before writing. Every run now maintains the specs repo itself: a Phase 0 preflight flushes leftover artifacts, retries an unpushed artifact commit, and settles the branch, and a terminal commit-artifacts step commits and pushes the run's feedback, follow-ups, and resume pointer — bounded to $SPECS_PATH's artifact paths and to plugin-created branches, always via git -C, never force-pushing, and never failing the run.

plugins.name: dt-style-guide
plugins.description: Dynatrace corporate style guide checker and writing-aid plugin. Enforces terminology, trademarks, voice/tone, grammar, formatting, and inclusive-language rules from styleguide.dynatrace.com. Includes dt-review-pr (review PR doc changes), dt-review-docs (review files/directories with optional --fix), dt-style-refresh (update vendored rules), a dt-style-rules skill, two dispatched sub-agents (dt-style-checker, dt-doc-fixer), and eight vendored reference docs. Acts as a fallback for dev-workflows when no repo-configured prose linter is available.

plugins.name: obsidian-llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM Wiki pattern for an active Obsidian vault. Eleven skills (wiki-init, wiki-ingest, wiki-scan, wiki-query, wiki-save, wiki-lint, wiki-hot, wiki-tags-refresh, wiki-schema, wiki-task, wiki-tasks-extract) for ingesting, querying, saving, linting, and managing a persistent wiki compiled from meetings, projects, and daily notes. Includes task management: create individual tasks and batch-extract tasks from wiki content.

plugins.name: acli
plugins.description: Atlassian CLI (acli) reference skill for Jira and Confluence: JQL search, work items, comments, links, attachments, watchers, projects, sprints, boards, filters, and Confluence spaces, pages and blog posts. Adds container-friendly authentication and a destructive-operation policy. Requires the acli binary on PATH.
